title: Raw colony picking benchmark (no screening) of E. coli and P. putida plates
goal: Measure detection and picking accuracy, precision, sensitivity and raw performance of COPICK on 44 plates (7,446 colonies) without selection criteria.

title: Color-based cherry-picking of blue vs white E. coli DH5α colonies on X-gal plates
goal: Test whether COPICK can select and pick 64 colonies ordered by dissimilarity to a reference blue color into a single-well plate.
unresolved_refs: Plate dilution factor described only as 'proper dilution factor'

title: Fluorescence-based cherry-picking of GFP-positive P. putida colonies
goal: Test whether COPICK can discriminate and pick the 30 most GFP-fluorescent colonies from a 50:50 mixture of P. putida TA245 (GFP-negative) and KT-GFP in descending brightness order.
